# Support

## Getting help

- **Site:** https://mycryptosignal.com
- **API docs:** https://mycryptosignal.com/docs/
- **Get a free API key:** https://mycryptosignal.com/get-access/
- **Email:** support@mycryptosignal.com

## This repository

This is the public, brand-facing repo for MyCryptoSignal. It presents what the site is and
publishes the frontend. The data engine and API gateway are private and are not published here.

For questions about the **frontend** (the code in `frontend/`), open a GitHub issue.

For questions about the **operated service** (the site, the API, your API key), contact
support@mycryptosignal.com.

## Security issues

Follow our [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md): report privately to security@mycryptosignal.com.
**DO NOT** open public issues for security vulnerabilities.
